mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear over Reddan Soccer Park with a temperature of 48 degrees, and please be aware that the air quality index is currently at 66.

Construction updates continue as Phase 2 of the Mark Drive project progresses, with underground utility work now finished and new concrete work underway on the west block. Also, the city's water utility offers a helpful Eye-On-Water program to monitor your usage.

There is a busy lineup ahead, starting today with live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, pizza at Lake Lou-ee, and trivia at The Bogey Factory. Tomorrow, look forward to ART House 360 and trivia at Hop Haus Brewing.
Regarding local public safety, the police department reported an incident on Thursday, October 15, where an officer arrested a school bus driver for O W I following reports of dangerous driving.
Today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Covered Strawberry, which is sure to be a treat. The restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM, so plan your visit accordingly.
